content: anyone using neovim for lean formalization , if i use mathlib project and invoke command lake exe cache get the lean.nvim plugin doesnot recognize the cache and tries to build the entire mathlib for my plugin how do you avoid this . If i open the same project in vscode , vscode plugin recognizes my mathlib and uses it to not build the entire mathlib and use the cahce instead

I assume you installed elan?

(lean.nvim works the same as VSCode in this matter, which is essentially it simply invokes lake, and it is that lake wrapper -- which comes from elan --'s job to ensure that the right version is selected for the project you are in)
yes elan is installed but why does my system default is 4.30.0 and vscode recognizes it and uses it but neovim uses 4.29.1 ? how is that possible if both use same commands ?
What file are you opening in Neovim?
Can you show me what you opened and how you opened it
Showing what :!type -a lake gives you in Neovim will also be helpful.

i used claude to check what is the problem apparently my nixos setup i am using nixvim to setup my neovim which comes with its own lean4 binary in my nixos store which does not use my elan installed lean or its cache
I wonder why does neovim plugin needs lean as its build dependency in the first place

I have no idea I'm afraid, I don't maintain or use nixvim. I'm not sure that's the case though? https://github.com/nix-community/nixvim/blob/41844750e55f17b1385d5b09ca7ade5f11f49506/plugins/by-name/lean/default.nix#L15 seems to say it's a normal dependency -- which is still wrong as it should install Elan.
